digest.component_or_area: LLM code-review overlay registry and workflow gates
propositions: The concurrency overlay must be registered in OVERLAY_IDS enum before the workflow can escalate to it from base review.

High-precision token tuple (Mutex, RwLock, Lock, Semaphore, synchronized, volatile, @GuardedBy, pthread_, go func, tokio::spawn, etc.) must trigger concurrency overlay when found in added or removed diff lines, excluding context-only occurrences and async/await family.
Concurrency overlay must route via advisory posture with 0.95 block threshold and blocking disabled, with routing entry in criteria_routing.json.
code-review.yaml must dispatch concurrency overlay via include_concurrency flag in both round_a and round_b gate batches following existing per-overlay pattern.
Unit tests must verify trigger fire on corpus-derived diffs, removal-path behavior, negative controls (async/await-only and context-line tokens), and unchanged deletion-impact behavior.
